body.title: Run the full sweep and record release verification
body.summary: Once all implementation tasks pass targeted checks, perform the combined build and single full sweep. Reconcile all in-scope root ranges, archived evidence and live-service coverage. Define the authenticated GitHub reconciliation procedure for after the default-branch scan.
acceptanceChecks: Record one full sweep after all implementation tasks pass targeted validation. Report pass, skip and failure counts and exact commands.
Check every captured in-scope root alert against every matching resolved dependency instance and preserve all four archived lockfiles byte-for-byte.
Keep eight low alerts outside the gate. Keep live alert reconciliation explicitly pending until a fresh authenticated default-branch scan check can verify each scoped alert.
Record each evidence-only alert and any ZIP advisory metadata discrepancy separately. Do not dismiss tracker alerts as a build side effect.

tests.name: Run root build and one combined repository test sweep after targeted task validation
Recompute all captured in-scope root ranges and byte-check the four archived lockfiles
